reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 7 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Rockets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.
